about: Entries of frus-name-authority's persons-complete.xml that merge two people, and what of each belongs to someone other than the person the entry is keyed to. PersonAuthorityIndexGenerator reads this file whenever it applies the overlay: for an entry carrying peopleId, the listed anchors join none of the entry's people-ids, and the listed Wikidata or VIAF id, and the listed role text, are stamped on none of them; the rest of the entry applies as before. Where joins names the other person's registry record, the listed anchors join it wherever no source answers for them. An identifier or role text is listed when it is not the keyed person's: the other person's, or someone else's that the reconciliation matched by name (each read on wikidata.org or viaf.org). A run refuses to write when the registry names peopleId otherwise than registryName or names joins.peopleId otherwise than joins.registryName, or when no entry carrying peopleId lists an anchor, identifier or role text given here. A listed anchor that no source answers and no join places belongs to no reconciled person, and the bundle lists it as apart, so the app never joins it to one by name. A join may name a registry record with no FRUS anchor of its own, which the bundle then keeps for the anchors it receives. assigned names anchors that no source gives to anyone, each with the registry record it belongs to, and each is written there; a run refuses to write when the registry names peopleId otherwise than registryName, when the registry answers for the anchor, or when an overlay entry gives it to another record. See PersonsCompleteCorrections.swift and Planning/Generators-Runbook.md.
